first_step_test: The trapezoid fixes the clip width, height, and flat lower edge, leaving both upper corners available for the two wire handles.

source.notes: Review the complete cumulative contact sheet before cropping; rejected iterations remain private.

final_elements.name: spring body
final_elements.description: One front-facing metal trapezoid with a narrower straight top and wider flat base.

final_elements.name: rolled top lip
final_elements.description: One narrow horizontal folded lip just below the top edge.

final_elements.name: left wire handle
final_elements.description: One thin loop rising from the upper-left hinge and folding inward above the body.

final_elements.name: right wire handle
final_elements.description: A separate thin loop rising from the upper-right hinge and folding inward beside the left loop.

final_elements.name: center seam
final_elements.description: One short central crease below the lip.

final_elements.name: ground shadow
final_elements.description: A short broken shadow directly below the base.

frames.visible_job: Draw one modest trapezoid with a narrow top and wider flat bottom.
frames.instruction: Sketch a short horizontal top edge, angle both sides outward, and connect them with a wider flat base. Leave open paper above the two top corners for the wire handles.

frames.visible_job: Add a narrow horizontal rolled lip inside the upper edge.
frames.instruction: Run one shallow line just below the top edge and join its ends to the upper corners. Keep the broad front face clear.

frames.visible_job: Attach one thin bent wire loop to the upper-left corner.
frames.instruction: From the left upper corner, lift a slim wire loop above the clip, curve it inward, and return it near the same hinge. Keep the loop open in the middle.

frames.visible_job: Attach a separate matching wire loop to the upper-right corner.
frames.instruction: Repeat the bent loop from the right upper corner, folding it inward beside the left wire without merging their two open centers.

frames.visible_job: Add a short center crease and broken base shadow.
frames.instruction: Place one short vertical crease beneath the folded lip, then sketch two or three light horizontal shadow strokes immediately below the flat base.

final_step.visible_job: Deepen the established body and wires with graphite without adding contours.
final_step.instruction: Use the side of a 2B pencil to darken the existing trapezoid, leaving a slim paper highlight near one edge. Strengthen the two wire loops, lip, crease, and broken shadow without changing their positions.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop has one centered narrow-top, wide-base trapezoid with stable corners and blank paper above both hinges.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: Six saved square crops show one binder clip with a stable body and lip, separate left then right wire loops, a center crease and short ground shadow before graphite finishing. No temporary guides are introduced or removed.
